title: Add Kiro Cli Launch Configurations
description: Add VS Code launch configurations for Kiro CLI: a run config (kiro-cli chat with compose agent and all trusted tools) and a debug config. Add to .vscode/launch.json following existing naming conventions.
summary: Added two VS Code launch configurations for Kiro CLI: 🚀kiro-cli (run with compose agent + all trusted tools) and 🐛kiro-cli (debug with verbose logging). Both use node-terminal type with kiro-cli chat --agent compose --trust-all-tools.
